Is the Japan Rail Pass still worth it?

Since the price increase in 2023, the seven-day Japan Rail Pass costs about 50,000 yen, which changes the maths for most itineraries. A round trip from Tokyo to Kyoto on the Nozomi now costs less than the pass by itself.

The pass still makes sense if you plan to cover several long routes in a week: Tokyo to Hiroshima and back, with a side trip to Nagano, adds up quickly. Regional passes are often the better choice for a slower trip.

What to compare

  • Total distance by bullet train
  • Whether your route uses Nozomi or Mizuho services
  • Regional alternatives such as the Kansai Wide Pass

Our advice: price the actual legs before you buy, and keep the receipts for the reserved seats.
